task_objective: Make scheduled verdict publication survive unrelated unstaged runner changes while preserving narrow staging, the unchanged-verdict early exit, and the single rebase-and-retry race path.

setup.remote_dev_pull: Attempted git pull --ff-only origin dev and recorded the failure at /tmp/decky-plugins-extended/verdict-push-fix-setup-error.log; origin exposes only main, so the clean local dev tip 70335c1 was used as the required base.
setup.plan_history: The plan was already committed as local dev tip 70335c1, so feat/verdict-push-fix inherited the required plan-first commit instead of creating a duplicate empty commit.
setup.tooling: The repository has no run.sh. XDG_CACHE_HOME was isolated under /tmp/decky-plugins-extended/uv-cache because the sandboxed global uv cache was read-only.

implementation.clean_tree_before_sync: After the narrow verdict commit succeeds, the publish step prints git status --porcelain and runs git reset --hard HEAD before the first pull --rebase. Bash fail-fast ordering ensures a failed commit exits before the reset.
implementation.preserved_behavior: The step still exits before committing when security-verdicts.json is unchanged, stages only security-verdicts.json, performs no force push, and retries exactly once by rebasing after a losing push race.
implementation.diagnostic_boundary: The diagnostic emits porcelain status codes and paths only; it does not read or print third-party file contents.

verification_evidence.pre_fix_reproduction: 1 failed before implementation with exit 128 and the exact error 'cannot pull with rebase: You have unstaged changes' after the verdict commit succeeded.
verification_evidence.fixture_controls: 10 passed across the executable publish-step fixture and workflow security tests. Real temporary bare repositories and clones proved dirty-tree publication, verdict-only commit contents, unchanged-verdict no-op behavior, one losing-race rebase and retry, failed-commit preservation, status-only diagnostics, scoped write permission, action SHA pins, and no secret interpolation in run blocks.
verification_evidence.failed_commit_control: A git wrapper forced commit to exit 42; the shell step stopped and the modified security-verdicts.json bytes remained present, proving reset did not run after commit failure.
verification_evidence.mutation_control: Temporarily removing git reset --hard HEAD made the dirty-tree publication test fail with exit 128 and the original unstaged-changes error. Restoring the reset returned the same control to 1 passed.
verification_evidence.local_real_audit: A disposable clone audited the actual SDH-Ludusavi v0.4.3 release. The audit exited 1 as AUDIT_ERROR because local ClamAV and Trivy executables were unavailable. git status --porcelain was empty, so no unexpected tracked dirtying file was observed locally; the runner-specific source remains unidentified.
verification_evidence.quality_gates: ruff check passed; 36 files already formatted; 248 passed and 21 subtests passed; no deleted review notes.

test_adjustment_rationale: No existing expected behavior was weakened. The workflow security test now enforces commit-before-diagnostic-before-reset-before-rebase ordering, and the new behavior suite executes the workflow's actual publish shell block against real git repository fixtures.
not_verified: No commit was pushed to GitHub and no scheduled or manually dispatched workflow run was triggered, as required by the plan.

The local real audit could not reproduce the scheduled runner's scanner environment because ClamAV and Trivy were unavailable; therefore it did not identify which tracked file dirtied the failed production runner.
The next scheduled run remains the first observation of the fix in GitHub Actions.
